```sql
with windows as (
    select 'previous_week' as key, date '2026-08-24' as start_date, date '2026-08-30' as end_date, 1 as sort_order
    union all
    select 'last_week' as key, date '2026-08-31' as start_date, date '2026-09-06' as end_date, 2 as sort_order
),
scope_orders as (
    select w.key,
           w.sort_order,
           o.order_id
    from windows w
    join orders o
      on o.business_date between w.start_date and w.end_date
    join showrooms s
      on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    where not o.is_test
      and s.country_code = 'GB'
),
per_order as (
    select so.key,
           so.sort_order,
           so.order_id,
           max(case when a.status = 'captured' then 1 else 0 end) as succeeded
    from scope_orders so
    join payment_attempts a
      on a.order_id = so.order_id
    where not a.is_test
    group by so.key, so.sort_order, so.order_id
)
select key,
       cast(sum(succeeded) * 1.0 / count(*) as decimal(38,12)) as value
from per_order
group by key, sort_order
order by sort_order
```
